keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Hull City 0, Ipswich Town 1. Florentino (Ipswich Town) right footed shot from a difficult angle on the right to the top right corner. Assisted by Abdoul Ouattara with a through ball.
Exequiel Palacios (Ipswich Town) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Hull City 0, Ipswich Town 1.
Substitution, Hull City. Matt Crooks replaces John Egan.
Second Half begins Hull City 0, Ipswich Town 1.
Elliot Stroud (Hull City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Hull City 1, Ipswich Town 1. Tim Iroegbunam (Hull City) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Oliver McBurnie.
Substitution, Hull City. Mohamed-Ali Cho replaces Elliot Stroud.
Matt Crooks (Hull City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Hull City 2, Ipswich Town 1. Oliver McBurnie (Hull City) from a free kick with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Substitution, Ipswich Town. Jack Clarke replaces Jaden Philogene.
Substitution, Ipswich Town. Azor Matusiwa replaces Florentino.
Substitution, Ipswich Town. Daizen Maeda replaces Abdul Fatawu.
Goal! Hull City 2, Ipswich Town 2. Julio Enciso (Ipswich Town) left footed shot from outside the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Azor Matusiwa.
Substitution, Ipswich Town. Zian Flemming replaces Emersonn.
Substitution, Hull City. Brooke Norton-Cuffy replaces Lewie Coyle.
Substitution, Hull City. Hidemasa Morita replaces Tim Iroegbunam.
Julio Enciso (Ipswich Town) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Semi Ajayi (Hull City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Hull City. Joe Gelhardt replaces Regan Slater.
Issa Diop (Ipswich Town) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Ipswich Town. Chuba Akpom replaces Julio Enciso.
